before.reason: Paragraph organisation requires writing for different purposes

after.reason: Stamina across purposes supports longer compositions, but a short focused experience or informational piece and a reasoned boundary repair can demonstrate paragraph organisation before full-page, multi-genre sustained writing.

before.reason: Organising paragraphs requires narrative writing ability

after.reason: Narrative authorship offers useful experience of sequence and coherence; organising complete non-narrative paragraphs and explaining their boundaries does not require independently authoring a beginning-middle-ending story first.

before.reason: Organising into paragraphs requires 'paragraph', 'heading', 'theme', and 'organisation' as named concepts

after.reason: Writing-process vocabulary supports discussing and refining organisation, but a learner can create focused paragraphs, choose headings and explain or repair a boundary in ordinary words without knowing the full process-term inventory.

before.reason: Generating effective questions requires knowledge of question words (who, what, where, when, why, how)

after.reason: Question words broaden and sharpen questions, but relevant yes/no clarification and requests for help can demonstrate the complete asking-and-answering operation without command of every question-word construction.

before.reason: Must be able to decode before fluency

after.reason: A wider range of grapheme-phoneme correspondences supports reading more texts; accurate, meaningful emergent reading of a text matched to already taught correspondences does not require responding to the entire 40+ phoneme inventory first.

unchangedBoundary: Left-to-right Understanding print hard gate is retained for the existing English reading context. No claim wording, source association or learner state changes.
scope: Intrinsic prerequisite corrections supported by within-English witnesses, not a general removal of language-specific requirements.

witnesses.positive: Read an unfamiliar-to-task emergent English text accurately and meaningfully using a small taught correspondence set; reread with improved pace/expression. Check another matched passage to distinguish decoding from memorised recitation.
witnesses.missingPrerequisite: The learner has not yet learned the full 40+ inventory.
witnesses.nearMiss: Repeating an adult-rehearsed passage, without reading a changed matched passage, does not establish this operation.
witnesses.transfer: Use different familiar words and a new text within the taught inventory.
witnesses.decision: The entire inventory is helpful for wider text access, not necessary before any matched emergent reading.

witnesses.positive: During an ambiguous task, ask a relevant yes/no clarification, request repetition/demonstration and answer a partner with necessary specific information. Vary the ambiguity so the learner cannot repeat a fixed prompt.
witnesses.missingPrerequisite: The learner does not command the complete who/what/where/when/why/how inventory.
witnesses.nearMiss: Parroting the adult question or guessing without clarification is insufficient.
witnesses.transfer: Seek new information in a different familiar activity and answer a changed clarification request.
witnesses.decision: Effective questions and answers can use yes/no forms and other relevant help-seeking constructions without all question-word categories.

witnesses.positive: Author a short focused non-narrative or experience piece with meaningful paragraph groups and a suitable heading; explain its boundaries in ordinary words. Then repair a different supplied text whose fact or boundary is misplaced and explain the repair.
witnesses.missingPrerequisite: The learner need not yet define every writing-process term, independently author a narrative beginning/middle/end, or sustain a full page across several genres.
witnesses.nearMiss: Copying supplied paragraph breaks, merely counting lines or writing unrelated sentences is insufficient.
witnesses.transfer: Create another focused piece for a changed purpose, and explain a different boundary repair.
witnesses.decision: The complete intrinsic paragraph claim is retained. Narrative, terminology and stamina are useful supports; none of their broader whole bundles is necessary for this demonstrated operation.

noScopeChange: All description, evidence and assessment fields remain exact. No learner equivalence, transfer, reset or downstream publication is authorised. Conditional language-framework links remain withheld until a later reviewed integration rechecks every hard path.
